user_objective: incremental net benefit of acting versus holding the existing position
baseline: R1_EMA_4h target-weight rebalance; R0_EMA_daily remains descriptive reference
eligible_state: existing positive long with EMA positive and mandatory risk checks passing
label_snapshot: after funding at t, before transition at t
terminal_reference: baseline hold-branch reference units at H, no new entries above current units; same units for both branches, jointly cash-feasible cap, cap flags retained
diagnostic_target: same delta normalized by initial portfolio NAV
funding_cash_deficit: abort whole stage; never drop future-dependent bad rows

model_plan.architecture: pooled linear, six frozen causal market features plus intercept
model_plan.weights: uniform over all admissible matured outcomes, wins and losses
model_plan.scaler: new train-only scaler at each origin
model_plan.prediction: incremental close-versus-hold net value bps of reference position notional
model_plan.policy_rule: close only if predicted net incremental value > 0; hold otherwise; mandatory baseline/risk exits override

label_maturity: H plus modeled fill delay; training cutoff additionally purged by seven 4h bars
fit_cost_scenario: stress; normal is replay sensitivity only, no second fitted objective
execution: modeled completed-close prices, proportional fees and adverse drag, fractional units; not qualified observed fills
registration_scope: semantic contract, pure accounting checks and parent lineage only; no labels, folds, scaler or fitted-model artifacts yet
future_registration_required: common bootstrap bank and independent audit bank hashes
scaler and model SHA per origin and decision
one predeclared fit and replay budget plus adaptive comparison ledger update
